# ADR-3018: A02: Custom crypto protocol for message lane 6

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Homegrown crypto fails subtly under real adversaries.

## Decision

Teams SHALL NOT invent a custom crypto protocol for message lane 6 (A02-6) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Use vetted libraries and protocols only.
